source: Kaptein et al., Policies on Paths (arxiv:2603.16586)

policies.name: Read chain then export — deny
policies.description: After N read-class tools, block data-export or bulk-write without HITL witness.
policies.datalog_rule: deny(S, export) :- session(S), read_count(S, N), N >= 3, proposed(S, export), export_class(export).
policies.eu_ai_act_framing: Art. 15 — unauthorized data egress from high-risk agent session

policies.name: Destructive burst cooldown
policies.description: Long sessions with repeated destructive tools require cooldown or HITL.
policies.datalog_rule: deny(S, T) :- session(S), step_count(S, C), C >= 80, destructive_burst(S, 5), proposed(S, T), destructive(T).
policies.eu_ai_act_framing: Art. 9 — systemic risk from unbounded destructive autonomy

policies.name: Memory write after untrusted read
policies.description: Block memory/vector writes when prior read steps lack trusted provenance.
policies.datalog_rule: deny(S, memory_write) :- session(S), prior_untrusted_read(S), proposed(S, memory_write).

policies.name: Fleet risk budget exhaustion
policies.description: Org-level cumulative risk score breach triggers HITL or hard block.
policies.datalog_rule: deny(T, A) :- tenant(T), fleet_risk(T, R), cap(T, C), R >= C, proposed_action(T, A).

policies.name: Delegation depth with monotonic scope
policies.description: Child delegation hop must not expand tool scope beyond parent ROA envelope.
policies.datalog_rule: deny(H, child) :- hop(H, P), parent_scope(P, S), child_scope(child, C), not subset(C, S).
